import json,os,datetime,subprocess,re,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
from collections import Counter
from src.tools.t01_partition import audited_result,sha_file
from src.tools import merge_pair_v2 as merge
ROOT=merge.ROOT.resolve(); NAME='diag_g01_next12_candidate_images_02'
assert os.environ['CVPR_RUN_NAME']==NAME
parent='gen_train_next12_60_01_retry1'; job='708238.hopper-m-02'
directory=ROOT/'logs/review/g01_next12_candidates_01'
assert not directory.exists(),'Preserve previous candidate publication'
scan=[]; images=[]; references=[]
for number in (8,9,10,205,206,207,302,303,304,402,403,404):
 scene=f'FloorPlan{number}'; source_path=ROOT/'results'/f'{parent}_c6_{scene.lower()}.json'
 if not source_path.exists():
  scan.append({'scene':scene,'source_file':str(source_path.relative_to(ROOT)),'source_ended':False,'scope':'No final scene result at this snapshot; no outcome inferred'}); continue
 data,ref=audited_result(source_path); cfg,m,meta=data['config'],data['metrics'],data['_meta']
 assert meta.get('end') and cfg['scene']==scene and cfg['shard']['pbs_jobid']==job
 assert cfg['producer_module']=='src.envs.pair_v2_g01_shard' and cfg['field_of_view']==60
 scan.append({'scene':scene,'source':ref,'source_ended':True,'source_end':meta['end'],'status':m['status'],'error':m.get('error'),
              'reported_passed_by_class':m['passed_by_class'],'cleanup_errors':m['cleanup_errors']})
 if not any(m['passed_by_class'][kind] for kind in ('look_flip','look_stay')): continue
 assert m['final_metrics_verified'] is True and m['terminal_verified_after_cleanup'] is True
 journal_ref={'file':cfg['attempt_journal'],'sha256':m['attempt_journal_sha256']}
 journal=merge.reference_path(journal_ref,root=ROOT,within=ROOT/'data/world_pairs/v2')
 rows=[json.loads(line) for line in journal.read_text().splitlines() if line.strip()]
 assert len(rows)==m['attempts'] and len({row['pair_id'] for row in rows})==len(rows)
 passed=[row for row in rows if row['status']=='passed']
 counts=Counter(row['kind'] for row in passed)
 assert {kind:counts.get(kind,0) for kind in merge.KINDS}==m['passed_by_class']
 assert [{'file':row['pair_file'],'sha256':row['pair_sha256']} for row in passed]==m['passed_pair_files']
 references.append(ref)
 for journal_index,row in enumerate(rows):
  if row['status']!='passed' or row['kind'] not in ('look_flip','look_stay'): continue
  pair_ref={'file':row['pair_file'],'sha256':row['pair_sha256']}
  pair_path=merge.reference_path(pair_ref,root=ROOT,within=ROOT/'data/world_pairs/v2')
  pair=json.loads(pair_path.read_bytes())
  raw_path=merge.reference_path(row['raw_attempt'],root=ROOT,within=cfg['raw_evidence_dir'])
  raw=json.loads(raw_path.read_bytes())
  for key in ('pair_id','scene','kind','status','discard_reasons'):
   assert pair[key]==row[key]==raw[key], 'Original pair/raw/journal identity mismatch'
  assert row['scene']==scene and row['discard_reasons']==[]
  image_ref=pair['review_image']
  assert image_ref in pair['portable_files'],'Original review not in original portable manifest'
  image_path=merge.reference_path(image_ref,root=ROOT,within=pair_path.parent)
  body=image_path.read_bytes(); assert body.startswith(b'\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n')
  images.append({'entry':{'pair_id':pair['pair_id'],'scene':scene,'kind':pair['kind'],
    'source':ref,'source_ended':True,'source_status':m['status'],'source_error':m.get('error'),
    'journal':journal_ref,'journal_index':journal_index,'raw_attempt':row['raw_attempt'],'pair_reference':pair_ref,
    'original_review_image':image_ref,'status':'candidate_image_not_independently_verified',
    'review_label':'候选图，尚未独立验收','independent_acceptance':None,'T02_acceptance':None},
    'bytes':body})
assert images,'No ended Look candidates available; no empty publication'
from types import SimpleNamespace
prior_failure,prior_failure_ref=audited_result(ROOT/'results/diag_g01_next12_candidate_images_01.json')
assert prior_failure['_meta']['exit_code']==1 and prior_failure['_meta'].get('end')
pbs=SimpleNamespace(returncode=None,stdout='',stderr='Previous logged qstat timed out; scheduler query not repeated')
match=None
parent_ref=None
parent_path=ROOT/'results'/f'{parent}.json'
if parent_path.exists():
 ended,parent_ref=audited_result(parent_path); assert ended['_meta'].get('end')
manifest={'created_at_utc':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
 'scope':'Original source-reported Look candidate review PNGs only. Source/journal/raw/pair/image byte identities verified; no independent scientific checkpoint executed.',
 'review_label':'候选图，尚未独立验收','parent_run_name':parent,'pbs_jobid':job,
 'parent_snapshot':{'qstat_returncode':pbs.returncode,'qstat_stdout':pbs.stdout,'qstat_stderr':pbs.stderr,
  'job_state':match.group(1) if match else None,'parent_running_at_capture':None if match is None else match.group(1)=='R','previous_scheduler_query_failure':prior_failure_ref,'parent_result_absent_at_capture':parent_ref is None,
  'parent_ended_result':parent_ref},
 'scene_source_snapshot':scan,'sources':references,'images':[],
 'independent_acceptance':None,'full_T02_acceptance':None,'human_review_approved':None,'is_checkpoint':False,
 'source_files_modified':False,'new_GPU_rendering':False}
directory.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False)
for index,image in enumerate(images):
 entry=image['entry']; destination=directory/f"{index:05d}_{entry['pair_id']}_{entry['kind']}.png"
 with destination.open('xb') as stream: stream.write(image['bytes'])
 assert sha_file(destination)==entry['original_review_image']['sha256']
 manifest['images'].append({**entry,'copied_review_image':{'file':str(destination.relative_to(ROOT)),'sha256':sha_file(destination)}})
path=directory/'manifest.json'
with path.open('x') as stream: json.dump(manifest,stream,indent=2,sort_keys=True,allow_nan=False); stream.write('\n')
print('G01_NEXT12_CANDIDATE_IMAGES_JSON: '+json.dumps({'manifest':{'file':str(path.relative_to(ROOT)),'sha256':sha_file(path)},
 'image_count':len(manifest['images']),'images':[{'pair_id':r['pair_id'],'scene':r['scene'],'kind':r['kind'],'copied_review_image':r['copied_review_image']} for r in manifest['images']],
 'review_label':manifest['review_label'],'parent_snapshot':manifest['parent_snapshot'],'independent_acceptance':None,'is_checkpoint':False},sort_keys=True,allow_nan=False),flush=True)
